title: The card reads complete in every empty state
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with edit-customer permission (which governs sending), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders and use a row's Contact button to open the contact card. Seed a worklist row: enrol an asset (asset Maintenance tab -> Enrol) whose customer has contact details.
  3. Rows to seed: a contact with no email; a contact with no phone; a contact with neither; and an asset with no preferred contact (set these on the customer/asset records).
custom_steps:
1. Open the card for a contact with no email, and one with no phone.
  2. Open the card for a contact with neither email nor phone.
  3. Open the card for an asset with no preferred contact.
  4. In each case judge whether the card reads as complete and whether a send action is offered.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The card renders a distinct state for a contact with no email, and for a contact with no phone.
  • A contact with neither email nor phone shows both empty states and no send action.
  • An asset with no preferred contact shows an empty state in place of the contact details, with an action to set one, and no send action until a contact exists.
  • The empty states read as complete rather than broken in every one of them.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10571 (S14, Contact the customer from a row); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S14; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S14-R8: “The card will render a state for a contact with no email, and a state for a contact with no phone number”
  • S14-N2: “A contact with neither email nor phone shows both empty states and no send action”
  • S14-N4: “An asset with no preferred contact shows an empty state in place of the contact details, with an action to set one. There is no send action until a contact exists”
  • S14-E1: “The empty states are common rather than exceptional, so the card must read as complete in every one of them”
